title: OptionSplitDatatypes 12.0.4 semantics: struct/array/pointer bit mapping, p1-assign/p2|p3-OR evaluation order, splitcopy/splitpointer group toggles, set/unchanged messages, error rejection, and <optionslist> XML decode
status_note: Commit c3d12a2 (OPTIONS-SPLITDATATYPE-SEMANTICS-0001) replaces the pre-12.0 semantics in src/options.rs (float=1/pointer=2 bits, none/both/all tokens, plural name splitdatatypes, ignored p3, no group toggles, no XML param reading, invented elem_ids 174-179) with the locked 12.0.4 behavior: OPTION_STRUCT=1/OPTION_ARRAY=2/OPTION_POINTER=4 (options.hh:336-341, reusing crate::arch::split_datatype), singular option name splitdatatype (options.hh:343, ElementId id 270 at options.cc:57), getOptionBit rejection text (options.cc:982-990), p1-assign + p2/p3-OR order with partial mutation before a later bad token throws and no toggle on throw (options.cc:1002-1016), set/unchanged messages (options.cc:1017-1020), decodeOne readString(ATTRIB_CONTENT) param reads (options.cc:167-181, mirrored by read_string_attr(AttributeId::new("XMLcontent",1))), error propagation out of decode, and the real elem_ids 201-204 (options.cc:50-53). The locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle and the frozen Rugra snapshot (complete git archive of c3d12a2, no overlays) were each executed twice with deterministic stdout/stderr: both sides produced 61 records / 2199 bytes with identical sha256 9ac77cabaa92c1b16c4b059f256f6ea63a9213b9c54a28fda84fb3f70799458f and empty stderr; the bilateral byte diff is empty. Residual wiring (registered, outside this fixture's claim): the (splitcopy, splitpointer) on/off pair is computed by split_action_toggles rather than applied to a live ActionDatabase group list because Architecture has no allacts field yet (the Rust fixture carries the same group-membership state with the exact toggleAction transition rules, and every observation matches the oracle's live allacts.getGroup(allacts.getCurrentName()) membership), and LowlevelError on unknown tokens is surfaced as message text prefixed 'LowlevelError: ' instead of a thrown exception.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Ghidra apply mutates glb->split_datatype_config through the Architecture pointer and mutates the current root's ActionGroupList through allacts.toggleAction(getCurrentName(), "splitcopy"/"splitpointer", on) (action.cc:1036-1053: addToGroup/removeFromGroup then clone+registerAction, updating currentact when grp==currentactname). Rugra apply mutates arch.split_datatype_config identically; the group mutation receiver (Architecture.allacts) does not exist yet, so the identical on/off pair is computed via split_action_toggles and the fixture observes the same membership transitions.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: No loops inside apply; the decisive order is: read oldConfig -> config=bit(p1) -> config|=bit(p2) -> config|=bit(p3) -> toggle branch -> message comparison. A bad p1 throws before any assignment; a bad p2/p3 throws after earlier assignments took effect (partial mutation, no toggleAction). decodeOne scans sub-elements linearly PARAM1->PARAM2->PARAM3, each opened only if the previous matched; with no children p1 comes from the outer element's ATTRIB_CONTENT text.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The configuration is a uint4 bit accumulator: the first parameter assigns the base value (empty string = 0), subsequent parameters OR in; it is never accumulated onto the previous configuration value. The old-configuration snapshot for the unchanged/set message is taken once at entry.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The toggle branch key is (config & (option_struct|option_array)) == 0 -> both groups off; else splitcopy on and splitpointer = (config & option_pointer) != 0. The message key is oldConfig == config string equality. getOptionBit compares tokens with exact string equality in the order empty/struct/array/pointer, anything else throwing LowlevelError('Unknown data-type split option: '+val). XML dispatch keys the option by the splitdatatype ElementId (270); param elements by ids 202-204.

covered_projection.name: OptionSplitDatatypes bits/name/messages/errors/toggles and the <optionslist> XML decode path

oracle_capture.note: BfdArchitecture x86:LE:64:default:gcc initialized from the locked tree; getOptionBit called statically; apply called on a directly constructed OptionSplitDatatypes against the live Architecture; XML decoded through the Architecture-owned OptionDatabase over xml_tree-parsed <optionslist> documents; group membership read from allacts.getGroup(allacts.getCurrentName()) (exactly what toggleAction mutates).

rugra_source_observation.note: src/options.rs get_option_bit (options.cc:982), OptionSplitDatatypes::apply (options.cc:999), split_action_toggles (decision decomposition of options.cc:1007-1016), OptionDatabase::decode_one ATTRIB_CONTENT param reads (options.cc:167-181) and error propagation, and elem_ids 201-204 (options.cc:50-53); default config 7 from Architecture::reset_defaults_internal (architecture.cc:1430-1431, src/arch.rs).

rugra_execution.note: The complete frozen crate snapshot (git archive of c3d12a2) was built with pinned Cargo/rustc and the Rust fixture executed twice identically: 61 records, 2199 stdout bytes, empty stderr.

bilateral_comparison.note: Locked Ghidra and Rugra stdout streams are byte-identical (diff exit code 0, empty diff): default config 7 and decompile group membership, all six token mappings and both rejection messages, all nine apply cases (including bad_p1 leaving config 7 and groups intact, bad_p2_partial leaving config 0 with stale group membership proving no toggle on throw, all3_repeat returning 'unchanged'), and all four XML cases (param1/param2 order -> config 5, bad token propagating out of decode with state untouched, no-children ATTRIB_CONTENT -> config 2 with splitpointer off, param3 -> config 7).

entrypoints: string OptionSplitDatatypes::apply(Architecture *,const string &,const string &,const string &) const (options.cc:999-1022)

analysis_options: BfdArchitecture target=default; no option overrides; the fixture itself applies splitdatatype options (direct apply and <optionslist> decode); observations read split_datatype_config, allacts group membership of the current root, and the returned/thrown messages

rugra_source.snapshot_model: immutable complete crate snapshot: git archive of the frozen production commit c3d12a2 carrying the OptionSplitDatatypes 12.0.4 semantics port; no source overlays

input_model.ghidra: BfdArchitecture over the pinned curl binary with the locked x86-64 sleigh/pspec/cspec; OptionSplitDatatypes exercised through direct apply calls and through <optionslist> XML documents parsed by xml_tree and decoded by the Architecture-owned OptionDatabase (XmlDecode).
input_model.rugra: Architecture::new (reset_defaults_internal default config 7) with archid pinned to the locked x86:LE:64:default:gcc; OptionDatabase::new registry; direct OptionSplitDatatypes::apply calls and OptionDatabase::decode over TreeDecoder trees whose param text values mirror the locked XML content onto the XMLcontent attribute (the ATTRIB_CONTENT encoding the packed wire format uses); group membership carried by the fixture with the exact toggleAction transition rules (initial decompile membership, recomputed only by successful applies).

residuals.detail: Architecture has no allacts (ActionDatabase) field yet, so apply() cannot perform the real toggleAction group mutation; the identical (splitcopy, splitpointer) decision is computed by split_action_toggles and the bilateral fixture observes the same membership transitions. Wiring point: add allacts to Architecture (action.rs ActionDatabase with toggle_action, action.cc:1036-1053) and forward the pair from OptionSplitDatatypes::apply. Interface consumers: subflow.rs SplitDatatype::new (subflow.cc:2706-2707, R15 review scope) should read split_structures/splitArrays from arch.split_datatype_config bits OPTION_STRUCT/OPTION_ARRAY once Architecture is threaded through.
residuals.evidence: apply.bad_p2_partial observes the no-toggle-on-throw timing on the oracle side via live group membership; the Rust fixture models the receiver with identical transitions.

residuals.detail: ArchOption::apply returns String (no error channel), so the LowlevelError Ghidra throws on unknown splitdatatype tokens is surfaced as message text prefixed 'LowlevelError: '; OptionDatabase::decode_one propagates such messages as Err, matching the C++ exception escaping decodeOne. A trait-level Result migration would remove the string-prefix convention.
residuals.evidence: bit.float/bogus, apply.bad_p1/bad_p2_partial/float_token, and xml.bad_token records are byte-identical on both sides.
